notes: Procedural depth in NFM A6.0 on whether one fixed measurement point represents a stream cross section — directly relevant to a fixed-position pod. Claims: a60-xcut-well-mixed-5pct-01 (profile values of pH, conductivity, temperature and DO differing by less than 5 percent across and top to bottom allow a single centroid point), a60-small-stream-centroid-01 (a well-mixed stream under about 5 feet wide), a60-edi-min-four-01 (EDI minimum four increments), a60-ewi-min-10-increments-01 (EWI minimum 10 equal-width increments in streams 5 feet or wider), a60-xcut-edi-60s-median-01 and a60-xcut-ewi-60s-median-01 (median of values observed within about 60 seconds after equilibration), a60-xcut-sw-60s-median3-01 (at least 60 seconds to equilibrate, median of the final three or more readings). Expected to favor rag: the slice describes what each metric means and how it behaves but says nothing about cross-section representativeness or increment counts.

turns.content: Our pod sits at one fixed spot mid-channel. How do we know that one spot speaks for the whole stream, and if it doesn't, how many spots do we need?

must_contain: States a single point at the centroid of flow is acceptable only after a profile shows the stream is well mixed
Gives the criterion that profile values of pH, conductivity, temperature and dissolved oxygen differ by less than 5 percent, both across the section and top to bottom
States a small well-mixed stream under about 5 feet wide can be represented by a single centroid point
States the equal-discharge-increment method needs a minimum of four increments
States the equal-width-increment method recommends a minimum of 10 increments in streams 5 feet wide or wider
must_not: Invents a percentage criterion for calling a stream well mixed
Claims a single mid-channel point is always representative
Invents an increment count the manual does not give

turns.content: Say we do have to work across the section. How long do we hold at each vertical, and what number goes in the log?

must_contain: States sensors need at least 60 seconds to equilibrate, or the manufacturer's stated time
States the value recorded at each vertical is the median of the values observed within about 60 seconds after the sensors have equilibrated
States the reported value for a measurement point is the median of the final three or more readings once the stabilization criteria are met
must_not: Says to log a single instantaneous reading at each vertical
Says to average the readings when the manual calls for the median
